name: Chat conversation
description: A messaging app card: contact name with an online dot, then chat bubbles appearing one by one (my messages dark on the right, theirs light on the left), a typing indicator before their replies, and an optional time-skip divider like '3 days later'.
use_when: Lines about talking to someone: a client, an editor, a friend, waiting for a reply, being ghosted, a DM or a customer message.

messages.help: [{from: 'me' or 'them', text}] in order; keep each under ~40 characters

divider.help: {after: index of the message it follows, text: '3 days later'}
